categories.main_business_segments: The company is a high-tech enterprise specializing in seismic isolation and damping (vibration control) technology. Main business segments include: (1) Building seismic isolation and damping products and services, including technical consulting, structural analysis and design, product R&D, production, sales, testing, installation guidance, and after-sales maintenance; (2) Seismic isolation rubber bearings, elastic sliding bearings, energy dissipation dampers, and seismic bracing systems; (3) Nuclear power seismic series products and services through subsidiary Changzhou Gelin; (4) Metro overhead building seismic isolation and vibration control products; (5) Vibration control series products for industrial and equipment applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in rubber formulation, adhesive bonding processes, vulcanization techniques, and damper production methods. Manufacturing capabilities include: production of full-series building seismic isolation rubber bearings, friction pendulum bearings, energy dissipation dampers (viscous, metallic yield, buckling-restrained, friction, and tuned mass dampers), vibration control support seats, steel spring isolation supports, and polyurethane vibration damping pads. The company operates advanced chemical and physical laboratories with specialized production workshops and production lines. Production follows 'make-to-order with reasonable inventory' model.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include construction contractors, project owners, and limited distributors. Main end markets are critical infrastructure and high-seismic-demand buildings: schools and hospitals (42% of 2024 revenue), airports and other public buildings (23%), commercial real estate, bridges, and other sectors. Secondary markets include metro overhead properties, industrial facilities, nuclear power plants, and high-precision equipment manufacturing. The company serves both domestic and international markets with focus on high-seismic-risk regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Kunming, Yunnan Province. Geographic segments include: Southwest Region (Yunnan base), North China Region, Northwest Region, and East-South Region. The company has established regional sales centers in Southwest, North China, and East-South regions with offices in multiple provinces. Subsidiaries operate in Hebei (Tangshan), Jiangsu (Changzhou), and Beijing. International presence is limited but expanding.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the seismic isolation and damping supply chain. Upstream: sourcing raw materials (rubber, steel, lead ingots, adhesives, coatings). Midstream: R&D, design, manufacturing, and quality testing of seismic isolation and damping products. Downstream: direct sales to construction contractors, project owners, and installation guidance. The company provides integrated solutions spanning from technical consulting through post-installation maintenance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Expanding market share in seismic isolation and damping products; (2) Developing 'dual-control' (seismic and vibration) technologies for metro overhead buildings and industrial applications; (3) Advancing smart monitoring systems for damping products; (4) Expanding into non-building sectors including industrial equipment, nuclear power, and precision manufacturing; (5) Promoting green and low-carbon building solutions; (6) Establishing national and international technical standards; (7) Developing economic benefit calculation methods for seismic isolation technology.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through: (1) Direct sales of seismic isolation and damping products (98% of 2024 revenue); (2) Technical consulting and structural analysis design services; (3) Installation guidance and after-sales maintenance services; (4) Product testing and certification services; (5) Other business revenue including equipment rental and material sales (1.94% of 2024 revenue). Revenue recognition occurs when customers obtain control of products, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance with signed receipt confirmation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the leading domestic enterprise in building seismic isolation and damping technology, and the only A-share listed company focused exclusively on this business. The company holds a high market share in China's building seismic isolation sector. Competitive advantages include: advanced technology, high product quality standards exceeding national standards, participation in 80 technical standards (4 national, 7 industry, 21 group, 41 local standards), strong R&D capabilities, and ability to provide integrated solutions. The industry has limited competitors with most being small-scale manufacturers lacking comprehensive capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: 2024 financial metrics: Revenue RMB 417.1 million (down 39.9% YoY), net loss RMB 141.0 million (vs. loss of RMB 41.1 million in 2023), total assets RMB 2.47 billion (down 6.4% YoY), shareholders' equity RMB 1.64 billion (up 4.8% YoY). The company experienced significant revenue decline in 2024 due to adjusted sales strategy prioritizing cash flow and stricter credit policies. Operating cash flow improved to RMB 96.1 million (up 23.4% YoY). The company is in a growth phase with established market position but facing near-term headwinds.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on: (1) Superior seismic protection through 'flexible seismic resistance' technology reducing structural damage and enabling lower-cost building design; (2) Comprehensive integrated solutions from consulting through maintenance rather than product-only offerings; (3) High-quality products exceeding national standards with proven performance in major earthquakes; (4) Technical expertise and standards-setting leadership; (5) Customized solutions for diverse applications beyond traditional building seismic isolation; (6) Green building benefits through reduced material usage and lower carbon emissions; (7) Proven track record on landmark projects including Beijing Daxing Airport and Beijing Capital Museum.
